source: Hamlet recently lost his father, the former King, who was also named Hamlet. He used to be very popular among those his age in Elsinore, with a much more cheerful disposition, but he's changed—and not for the better.
target: 哈姆雷特最近失去了父亲，也就是同样名叫哈姆雷特的先王。他过去在埃尔西诺的同龄人中很受欢迎，性情也开朗得多，可他变了——而且是变糟了。
